decisions.why: Nelson Metzenbaum and Vannas Scissors are general surgical scissors used in theatre procedures.
Lister Goniotomy, Colibri Barraquers and Teale Vulsellum Forceps are all ophthalmic surgical forceps.
Barraquer, Castroviejo and Gillies needle holders are general surgical instruments for suturing in theatre.
Fison, Turner Warwick and Canny Ryall retractors are general theatre instruments for exposure during procedures.
Jacobsen, Potts Smith and Cushing dissecting forceps are general surgical instruments used in theatre.
Miles Phillips, Fickling and Ochsner artery forceps are general theatre instruments for vascular haemostasis.
Barrons, Schucknecht and Brompton suction tubes are general theatre consumables for surgical aspiration.
Thomson Walker, Seton Pringle and Payr clamps are general theatre instruments for occlusion and haemostasis.
Hartmann Heavy Aural Forceps, T-Tube Inserter and Tabb Crura Nippers are specifically ENT surgical instruments.
Examples include Tumarkin Aural Speculum (ENT) and Graves Speculum (gynecology), spanning two surgical specialities.
Kratz Barraquer Specula, Vannas Scissors Titanium and Capsulorhexis Forceps are all ophthalmic microsurgical consumables.
Chavasse Stab Hook, Rollet (Iris) Hook and Strabismus Hook are ophthalmic surgical consumables.
Generic tissue forceps including Duval and Babcock types are general theatre instruments for grasping tissue.
Yeoman, Walton and Tischler Morgan biopsy forceps are standard endoscopy consumables for tissue sampling.
Ferris Smith and Pennybacker bone punch forceps are general theatre instruments for neurosurgery and orthosurgery.
McIndoe, Smith Petersen and Swedish chisels are theatre instruments for bone work in surgery.
Howarth, Campbell Reid and Harrington spinal elevators are theatre instruments for bone elevation.
Semb and Walsham bone holding forceps are theatre instruments for stabilizing bone during procedures.
Pennybacker bone nibbler and Stille Liston bone cutting forceps are theatre instruments for bone resection.
Edna, Moynihan and Armour towel clips are theatre consumables for securing surgical drapes.
Silkus, Prolus, Nylus and Estralus sutures are absorbable and non-absorbable general theatre consumables.
Syme, Mollison and Kocher dissectors are theatre instruments for tissue dissection in surgery.
Horrocks, Gelabins and other uterine dilators/sounds are gynaecology instruments for examining the uterus.
Stookey, Northfield and Heanley rongeurs are theatre instruments for bone work and resection.
Stille, Hibbs and Smith Petersen osteotomes are theatre instruments for cutting bone.
St Clair Thomson adenoid curette and other curettes are theatre instruments for tissue removal.
Swedish, Smith Petersen and Jenkins gouges are theatre instruments for bone shaping.
Examples include Split Eye Probe (ophthalmic) and Moynihans Gallstone Probe (general surgical), spanning two contexts.
Diathermy insulation testers, monopolar and bipolar forceps are electrosurgery consumables used in theatre.
Mushroom manipulator, mayo pins and similar items are miscellaneous theatre surgical instruments.
Tendon tunnelling forceps and tendon retrievers are theatre instruments for tendon surgery.
Lane, Fagge and Hohmann-Mueller bone levers are theatre instruments for bone manipulation.
Pro300, Titan X400 and LED surgical light sources are capital OR equipment for theatre integration.
Barrons and Beaver blade scalpel handles are general theatre consumables for incision.
Volkmann and Macewen scoops are theatre instruments for scooping tissue or bone.
Okcel oxidised cellulose and Cutanplast gelatin haemostats are theatre consumables for haemostasis.
Rydel Seiffer, aluminium and Gardiner Brown tuning forks are diagnostic equipment for hearing and neurological assessment.
LX2, SSL-5500 and SSL-9500 surgical headlights are capital OR equipment for theatre integration.
LX2+Headlight Camera and FIS005 inspection cameras are capital OR equipment for documentation and visualisation.
Sommerlad and Echoffs mapping pens are theatre consumables for intraoperative marking.
Fibre optic light source cables are capital OR infrastructure components for surgical lighting systems.
Laryngeal mirrors are ENT surgical instruments for throat and laryngeal examination and procedures.
